description: Bus line stations in Riyadh by bus line, direction and shelter type (2024) is a dataset listed in RCRC Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Royal Commission for Riyadh City. Bus line stations as planned once the whole bus network is developed in Riyadh city. Data for the year 2024. 1.Methodology The name and location of stations are extracted from the information system of Riyadh Bus. Coverage: Riyadh. The portal files it under 07-Territories, Transport & Services. Its keywords are Intra-Riyadh, Public transport. The portal shows 3,010 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is KSA Open Data License: this license provides freedom to the users in distributing, producing, and transforming works regarding datasets, as well as building upon them. The source should be mentioned in the prescribed manner in the license. (https://open.data.gov.sa/odp-public/static/en/assets/Open_Data_License_En.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-rcrc-gov-sa-portal.
